sentences.en: It is best to review the material before the presentation.
sentences.zh: 在演示之前最好先复习一下材料。

sentences.en: I didn't prepare a presentation. So I just blagged it.
sentences.zh: 我没有准备演示，所以就临时发挥了一下。

sentences.en: The professor gave a presentation on the history of France.
sentences.zh: 教授做了一场关于法国历史的报告。

senses.zh: 提供, 显示 - 外观 - 授予(物), 赠送(仪式) - 报告 - 表演 形容词: presentational

mnemonic: 词根记忆：present（展示）+ation（行为）→介绍
